title: PewPlay game.json
description: PewPlay game metadata. All fields are optional.

description.description: Short description for Google and shared links (50–160 characters).

about.description: About the game: 1–3 paragraphs shown on the game page (separate paragraphs with an empty line: \n\n). The most important text for Google.

howToPlay.description: How to play: one or two paragraphs shown on the game page.

controls.description: Comandi mostrati nella pagina del gioco.

tips.description: Short tips, one sentence each (shown as a list).

faq.description: Frequently asked questions shown on the game page.

category.description: Categoria. Quelle standard vengono tradotte automaticamente.

tags.description: Parole chiave (3–8), usate per ricerca e SEO.

orientation.description: Orientamento consigliato su mobile: mostra un suggerimento "ruota il dispositivo".

cover.description: Cover image 16:9 (recommended 1280×720). Default: cover.png in the repo root. Used for the Play screen, featured games and shared links.

screenshots.description: Screenshots (recommended 1280×720). Default: all images in the screenshots/ folder.

featured.description: Mostra il gioco tra i primi in home.

added.description: Data di pubblicazione (AAAA-MM-GG): badge "Nuovo" per 30 giorni e ordinamento.

draft.description: true = never published on the public site, even from main.
